name: Matrix Commutator Norm Obfuscation
description: Replaces a simple vector dot-product interaction with the squared Frobenius norm of the commutator of $3 \times 3$ matrices ($||AB - BA||_F^2$). The matrices are constructed from generators of SO(3) such that the norm evaluates to a constant positive value for any pair of distinct matrices, and 0 for identical matrices. Combined with an indirectly stated maximum capacity bound, it forces the model to perform matrix algebra to discover the underlying binary relation before it can even formulate the constraint.
